A '''master summoner''' was a practicioner of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] alchemy during the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]]. [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Sorzus Syn]] was the greatest of the master summoners during the war.<ref name="Book of Sith" />
